The '''Neona Military Academy''' was a military educational facility located on the planet [[Neona]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It provided officers for the [[Freeworlds Common Navy]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
